t: This is Bessborough Gardens, a garden square in Pimlico. It is named after John Ponsonby, the 4th Earl of Bessborough, a Whig politician who was known as Viscount Duncannon for much of his life. He served as Home Secretary in 1834, and in 1846 he became Lord Lieutenant of Ireland, holding that post until 1847, in the first years of the Great Famine.
